name: Hamaguchi Heisuke
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives with his parents and his older and younger brothers.
He's smart and has good reflexes, but because he's short and a bit scatterbrained his flirtations always get denied.
He always feels the need to compete with his older brother but he loves his younger brother dearly.
